title: Cluster health (EKS)
description: The platform signals from examples/monitoring-eks.yaml: alerting pipeline, API server and etcd, nodes, workloads and cert-manager.

panels.title: Missed rule evaluations (1h)
panels.description: Prometheus could not finish a rule group within its interval. The stress run saw this at 102k series with 200m CPU; size Prometheus first.

panels.title: Head series
panels.description: Active series. Memory is roughly 7 KiB per series (stress run: 695 MiB at 102k).

panels.title: Rule groups: evaluation time over interval (top 10)
API server 429 and 5xx
panels.description: Error-budget burn around control-plane restarts and upgrades is expected; it is the platform team's, not application owners'.

panels.title: Read latency p99 (single objects and namespaces)

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (verb, le) (rate(apiserver_request_sli_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", job="apiserver", verb=~"GET|LIST", scope=~"resource|namespace", subresource!~"proxy|attach|log|exec|portforward"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (verb, le) (rate(apiserver_request_sli_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", job="apiserver", verb=~"POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE", subresource!~"proxy|attach|log|exec|portforward"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: API Priority and Fairness rejections
panels.description: Requests the API server answered 429 because their priority level's queues were full. kubesentry has its own flow schema when its chart sets apf.enabled.

panels.title: etcd database size
panels.description: When etcd reaches its quota the cluster stops accepting writes.

panels.title: Event writes per second
panels.description: Events are stored in etcd for an hour on EKS. KubeEventVolumeHigh fires above 20/s for 30 minutes.

panels.title: Lowest memory available (10 nodes)
panels.description: Stress runs saw real nodes at 4% available during churn; below about 10% the kubelet starts evicting.

panels.title: Clock offset (10 largest)
panels.description: Token validation and SigV4 break as clocks drift. NodeClockOffsetCritical fires above 10s.

panels.title: Disk IOPS per device (top 10) against the gp3 baseline
Disk throughput per device (top 10) against the gp3 baseline
Disk queue depth (top 10)
panels.description: Average requests in flight. At gp3 latencies, 3,000 IOPS needs a queue of about 3; a sustained queue above 8 means requests wait for the volume.

panels.title: OOM kills in the last hour by namespace (top 10)

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (namespace) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$cluster"}[1h]) and on (namespace, pod, container) kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{cluster=~"$cluster", reason="OOMKilled"} == 1))

panels.title: Certificates expiring within 14 days
panels.description: Includes short-lived certificates that renew on schedule; the alerts only count certificates past their renewal time.
